name: Ponder
description: Create's animated help: hold W over an item.

pages.title: Ponder
pages.text:
**Ponder** is Create's animated help. Hover over almost any Create item, in your inventory or JEI, and hold **W**. A scene shows how it works.\
\
Many add-ons use Ponder too. It is the first place to look for how a machine behaves.
